note: Adapted from the species description of Chhotani (1997), originally in English; all three castes are described, and the antennae of the alate specimen are broken, with only 11 segments preserved; synonymy citations, nomenclatural and type-material records, distribution and figure numbers are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule chestnut brown, fontanelle region paler; nasus darker than head; antennae tinged with brown; pronotum slightly paler than head; abdominal tergites straw yellow, sternites nearly white. Vertex with a pair of long setae, base of nasus with a pair and one or two additional long setae, minute hairs elsewhere; tip of nasus with a tuft of short hairs; pronotum densely covered with minute hairs; each abdominal tergite with one long seta on each lateral margin and a pair at the middle, minute hairs elsewhere; sternites with long and short hairs. Body length 3.2–4.0 mm. Head capsule pyriform; base of nasus with a minute projection on each side (1.40–1.52 mm long including nasus, 0.84–0.95 mm long excluding nasus, 0.83–0.91 mm maximum width); in lateral view straight, nasus swelling weak. Nasus short, almost cylindrical (0.50–0.58 mm long, nasus length/head length index 0.56–0.58). Antennae 12-segmented; segment 3 about one and a half times segment 2. Mandibles vestigial, each with a short brown spine-like process. Pronotum saddle-shaped (0.17–0.22 mm long, 0.40–0.53 mm wide); anterior margin very weakly notched, posterior margin straight.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule brown; antennae and labrum straw yellow; pronotum slightly paler than head; abdomen yellowish white. Pilosity of head and body moderate, of long and short hairs. Body length 3.8–5.0 mm. Head capsule subquadrate (0.85–0.98 mm long to base of mandibles, 0.95–1.10 mm maximum width). Fontanelle plate slightly long, translucent. Antennae 13-segmented; segment 3 subequal to segment 2. Postclypeus inflated, hairy; nearly 1/2 as long as wide (0.20–0.23 mm long, 0.45–0.50 mm wide). Pronotum saddle-shaped (0.20–0.30 mm long, 0.50–0.65 mm wide).

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule pale reddish brown; postclypeus, labrum and antennae pale golden yellow; pronotum pale yellowish brown; abdominal tergites light brown; legs yellow. Pilosity of head and body moderate. Body length 11.8 mm. Head capsule subcircular (1.05 mm long to base of mandibles, 1.20 mm wide including compound eyes). Fontanelle plate long, obtusely Y-shaped (0.15 mm long). Compound eyes medium-sized, circular, moderately protruding (0.32 mm maximum diameter). Ocelli elliptical (0.15 mm long, 0.08 mm wide); separated from compound eye by about one short diameter (0.08 mm). Antennae broken, with only 11 segments preserved; segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2, segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus inflated, semicircular (0.20 mm long, 0.50 mm wide), hairy. Pronotum nearly trapezoidal (0.55 mm long, 0.98 mm wide); anterior margin weakly notched, posterior margin slightly incurved.
